Create a professional report or update regarding Jira ticket [{key}] "$1".

jiraTodoPrompt.message: Analyze this Jira Ticket and automatically break it down into detailed sub-tasks for developers. Finally, export the task list as a single JSON Array at the end of your response, wrapped inside a ```json [ ... ] ``` code block (each element has structure: {"title": "Short task name in English", "phase": "3. Implementation & Coding", "priority": "HIGH" | "MEDIUM" | "LOW", "detail": "Short description of what to do"}). Make sure the JSON is valid so the system can parse and inject it directly into your Todo project.

jiraOpsPrompt.message:
Analyze this Jira Ticket's requirements. Provide the following detailed sections:
1. Summarize Core Business Requirements.
2. Identify and analyze business/tech contradictions or potential risks - minimum 3 points.
3. Provide 3-5 elegant, professional Q&A questions in polite Japanese Keigo to send to the client/partners to clarify the above contradictions/risks.
4. Suggest at least 5 detailed Action Items for developers to implement this feature.
